address: 98 To Ngoc Van Street, Quang An Ward, Tay Ho District, Hanoi, 11207, Vietnam
bio: In keeping with its name, which means hello, friend in Vietnamese, Chào Bạn is welcoming and easy-going. In the kitchen, chef Madame Hang gives traditional Vietnamese recipes a new spin with creativity and aplomb. Her nem rán cua (crab spring rolls) deliver balanced flavours and contrasting textures. The đặc biệt section, which includes prawns in coconut cream, or lacquered pork ribs, is a treasure trove of her creative signature dishes....
